description: This file defines Flask request and response wrapper classes, extending Werkzeug's Request and Response classes, with additional Flask-specific attributes and behaviors.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A Flask-specific request class extending Werkzeug's Request, adding Flask attributes and properties for URL rules, view args, routing exceptions, and configuration-based limits.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A Flask-specific response class extending Werkzeug's Response, with default MIME type and configuration-based max cookie size.

methods.name: max_content_length
methods.description: Property to get or set the maximum content length for the request, configurable per request or via app config.

methods.name: max_form_memory_size
methods.description: Property to get or set the maximum size of non-file form data, configurable per request or via app config.

methods.name: max_form_parts
methods.description: Property to get or set the maximum number of form fields, configurable per request or via app config.

methods.name: endpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint matched for the request URL, or None if not matched.

methods.name: blueprint
methods.description: Returns the name of the current blueprint, or None if not in a blueprint.

methods.name: blueprints
methods.description: Returns a list of registered blueprint names up the hierarchy.

methods.name: _load_form_data
methods.description: Loads form data, attaching debug helpers if in debug mode.

methods.name: on_json_loading_failed
methods.description: Handles JSON loading failures, raising BadRequest, with debug considerations.

methods.name: max_cookie_size
methods.description: Read-only property returning the maximum cookie size from app config.
